title: Golf Round Strokes Gained Goal Adherence by Course
dataSources: Golf rounds (`golf:round`), Garmin golf telemetry (`garmin:golf`), UDisc rounds (`udisc:round`), launch-monitor shots (`launchmonitor:shot`), handicap-index updates (`handicap:index`).
app: Arccos and Garmin S62 round telemetry, UDisc round exports, launch-monitor CSVs, and handicap-index updates streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted imports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=golf:round
| stats avg(strokes_gained_total) as actual count as sessions by course_name
| eval pct_of_goal=round(100*actual/0.5,1), goal_label="0.5"
| sort pct_of_goal
description: Compares average strokes gained with a simple target for each course, showing where golf round strokes gained is meeting plan and where it is lagging.
value: Splitting target adherence by course shows which contexts are helping you hit the plan and which ones need adjustment.
implementation: Set the target value in the query to match your routine, then review low-adherence course values before the next session block.
visualization: Table of course values with average strokes gained and percent of goal.
grandmaExplanation: It counts which course settings help you hit your target for golf round strokes gained and which ones fall short.
